chunks: And in the narration of Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:
"Fasting is only observed on Wednesday because no nation in times past was punished except on a Wednesday in the middle of the month; so it is recommended that that day be fasted."

key_terms.يُصَامُ: is fasted; observed as a fast

ai.seo_question: Why is fasting on Wednesday in the middle of the month recommended in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that fasting on a Wednesday in the middle of the month is recommended. The reason given is that past nations were punished on such a day, so fasting it became a mustahabb devotional practice.
